name: floating-panel

frames.best_why: The panel is open with a typed note inside, showing the trigger turned into a working form.
frames.render_note: The open panel clips its footer, so no Submit Note or close control is ever visible.

tagline: A note button unfurls into a small writing panel with a textarea.
summary: A compact Add Note button that expands into a floating card holding a title, a labelled textarea and, in the code, close and submit actions.
appearance: A small dark rounded Add Note button sits alone on black. Clicked, it becomes a wider dark card below with a bold title, a Write your note label and a large empty text area; the original button stays as a blurred ghost.
behaviour: The trigger button morphs into the panel with a spring while the backdrop blurs slightly; clicking outside or pressing Escape closes it and clears the note.
demo_content: Button and panel titled Add Note with the label Write your note and the typed line Ship the pricing page on Friday.
search_phrases: button that opens a note form
small writing popup for quick notes
click to add a note panel
use_when: Users need to jot a short note from one button without leaving the page or opening a full form.
avoid_when: The panel anchors below the trigger and the fixed-height demo clips its footer actions.
customise: Trigger label, title, textarea and footer actions are composed from exported parts; panel size and the spring are set in the demo and source.
weight_why: One panel and a blurred backdrop, animated only while opening or closing.

a11y.note: The dialog does not trap focus or restore it, and the trigger's aria-expanded stays false even while the panel is open.

issues: The fixed-height panel clips its footer, so Submit Note and the close arrow never show.
The trigger's aria-expanded stays false while the panel is open.
Focus is neither trapped in the dialog nor returned to the trigger.
The label fades to nothing as soon as text is typed, leaving the textarea unlabelled.
polish_why: The morph and blurred backdrop are nice, but the clipped footer makes the panel look unfinished.
